parameters.content:
## Workflow B v2 - one personal episode per listener, researched live
1. *Plan research* turns the request, length and host into 1-3 research briefs. 2. *OpenAI research* searches the web, only on trusted outlets that we can read back. 3. *Fetch source* + *Verify facts* read every source page: the quote must be on the page and every number too, or the fact is dropped. 4. *Writer request* - the host tells it as one story at the chosen length; *Check length* adds more context if it is short. 5. *Build script & gate* drops any segment with a number or fact without a verified source, or anything that sounds like investment advice. 6. ElevenLabs with timestamps, *Package result* -> lb_jobs / lb_audio for the website.
